description: This file contains helper functions for logging messages to the system logger, including functions for different log levels (regular, error, debug) which format messages with component and subcomponent identifiers and send them via the logger command.

methods.name: ulog
methods.description: Logs a message with 'notice' priority to system logger, including component and subcomponent info.

methods.name: ulog_error
methods.description: Logs a message with 'error' priority to system logger, including component and subcomponent info.

methods.name: ulog_debug
methods.description: Logs a message with 'debug' priority to system logger, including component and subcomponent info.
